description: Add narrative wave detection + serial deployer filter (+29pp and -50pp edges from backtest research). Creates DeployerTracker and WaveDetector modules with SQLite persistence, integrates into scanner.py pipeline.
steps: Create memescanner/deployer_tracker.py with DeployerTracker class using aiosqlite
Create memescanner/wave_detector.py with WaveDetector class using aiosqlite
Update scanner.py pipeline: add serial deployer filter BEFORE DEX check, add wave multiplier BEFORE P(2x) filter
Update format_telegram_message to include wave info line when applicable
Add cycle logging for both new filter steps
acceptance_criteria: DeployerTracker maintains deployers SQLite table with twitter_account, token_count, last_seen, tokens_json
DeployerTracker.is_serial_deployer returns True for accounts with >= 2 prior tokens
DeployerTracker.record_token adds token to account history
DeployerTracker.get_deployer_count returns count of deployed tokens
Known serial deployers pre-seeded: narrafinder, thetrencherya, grana_pome, korean_bags
WaveDetector maintains wave_keywords SQLite table with keyword, appearances, last_seen, avg_mc
WaveDetector.get_hot_keywords returns keywords appearing in 3+ top tokens
WaveDetector.get_cold_keywords returns keywords from dead tokens
WaveDetector.get_wave_multiplier returns 1.6 for HOT, 0.3 for COLD, 1.0 for neutral
Scanner pipeline: Fetch -> Twitter -> Serial Deployer -> Age -> DEX -> Rug -> On-chain -> Wave Multiplier -> P(2x) -> Alert
Serial deployer rejection skips DEX/on-chain checks (saves API calls)
Wave multiplier applied before P(2x) cap (re-cap at 45%)
Telegram message includes wave info line when applicable
findings: All 239 tests pass (192 existing + 47 new). DeployerTracker uses aiosqlite with shared memescanner.db, pre-seeds 4 known serial deployers, normalizes account names to lowercase. WaveDetector maintains in-memory cache refreshed from DB, initial HOT/COLD keywords always active, dynamic keywords decay after 24h. Scanner pipeline updated: serial deployer filter before DEX (saves API calls), wave multiplier after on-chain and before P(2x) cap. Telegram message shows fire/snowflake emoji wave line when keyword matched. HOT takes priority over COLD when both match.
